## Native, media and platform requirements

- **OpenCV and OpenCV contrib contributors**: recorded source checkouts use Apache-2.0; root notices are retained. aruco/objdetect functionality is used through OpenCV APIs, not a separately vendored AprilTag implementation.
- **The HDF Group, University of Illinois and other named HDF5 contributors**: full custom redistribution terms are retained for installed HDF5 1.14.3 and 1.14.4. Preserve their copyright, terms, disclaimer and named-endorsement restrictions; additional notices referenced by those files remain relevant if shipping HDF5 binaries.
- **libaec contributors / Deutsches Klimarechenzentrum**: compression-library notice is retained from the installed conda package; the shadow build also links `sz` and `aec`. Preserve corresponding build/package terms if distributing those libraries.
- **FFmpeg contributors**: external executable; LGPL/GPL status depends on the exact build. See [upstream legal guidance](https://ffmpeg.org/legal.html). No media executable or linked FFmpeg library is shipped here.
- **Python Software Foundation and Python contributors**: separately installed interpreter and standard library; [PSF license terms](https://docs.python.org/3/license.html) apply to their distribution. No interpreter is bundled.
- **GNU compiler/runtime and system C/C++ libraries**: external build/runtime tools; GCC GPL/runtime-exception and platform-specific library terms apply to their own distributions. No compiler or native executable is bundled.
- **Microsoft .NET/WPF**: reference sources depend on System/Windows types, CommunityToolkit.Mvvm, OpenCvSharp and Microsoft ONNX Runtime. Exact target framework/package versions are outside the incomplete project snapshot; do not infer Windows runtime redistribution permissions from the .NET source license alone.
- **NVIDIA CUDA** and **Qualcomm QNN / AI Engine Direct**: external, version-specific proprietary toolkit/runtime terms; neither runtime is bundled or relicensed. Device providers and names are credited for the deployment interfaces used.

The external DA3 project has its own dependency tree (including model/geometry,
server/export and optional streaming/GS components). It is not packaged here.
The pinned upstream tree and its nested file-level notices control any later
redistribution; do not treat this source archive as a complete environment SBOM.

Import evidence and hashes for all retained notices are in
[license-evidence.json](../../provenance/license-evidence.json).

Additional bundled codec notices from the installed numcodecs distribution are retained in its `licenses/` subtree and fully indexed in the evidence manifest.
